label: EU-ivdr-2017 Article 80

obligations.text:
Post-market surveillance report
Manufacturers of class A and B devices shall prepare a post-market surveillance report summarising the results and conclusions of the analyses of the post-market surveillance data gathered as a result of the post-market surveillance plan referred to in Article 79 together with a rationale and description of any preventive and corrective actions taken.
The report shall be updated when necessary and made available to the notified body and the competent authority upon request.
